prompts.text: Turn on sub-agent mode on this chat's prompt queue in C:\dev\abd-cdd-simple-queue-enhancement, and queue the demo items below so they group into three sub-agent columns. None of them may change any tracked file in the repository: each writes only inside a scratch folder under the session's work folder, .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/<agent-name>/.

Demo task for sub-agent Sparky: create .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/sparky/, give your queue card the steps 'count files', 'write report', 'mark done' with prompt-queue.set_steps, then count the .py files under tools/prompt_queue (read only) and write the count and file list to demo/sparky/report.md, ticking each step done with prompt-queue.step_done as you finish it, then mark the card done.

Demo task for sub-agent Bolt: create .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/bolt/, give your queue card three steps with prompt-queue.set_steps, read .context/story-map.md (read only) and write the titles of every story under the Queue Prompts For Later epic to demo/bolt/stories.md, ticking each step done as you go, then mark the card done.

Demo task for sub-agent Gizmo: create .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/gizmo/, give your queue card four steps with prompt-queue.set_steps, wait about 20 seconds between steps so its progress can be watched moving on the card, write one line per step to demo/gizmo/progress.log, tick each step done as you go, then mark the card done.

Demo task for sub-agent Rivet, to show a decision being parked: create .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/rivet/, give your card two steps, finish the first by writing demo/rivet/note.md, then end your turn asking the person 'Keep note.md or delete it?'; if no answer comes within a minute, put the card back with prompt-queue.edit starting '[decision required]' and move on, as the queue's never-go-idle rule says.

While the demo sub-agents run, send two short messages to this chat: one about Bolt's task ('also list the story count') and one unrelated ('what time is it'). Check that the first is filed under Bolt's goal as an [interruption] step and the second gets a card of its own, and report where each landed.

Check the demo run: read the queue with prompt-queue.show and report, for each demo card, its sub-agent name, its steps and their states, and whether it is done; confirm each sub-agent wrote only inside its own .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/<name>/ folder and that git status shows no change to any tracked file outside .sessions.
Clear the queue and confirm the demo cards were archived as JSON in .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/queue-archive/, then list what the newest archive file holds.

Delete the .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/ folder so the demo leaves nothing behind, confirm git status is clean apart from session files, and record on the story map what the multi-agent demo showed working and what did not.
